A.lower: Available positive reporting and procedures outweigh the documented bounded concerns.

A.limits: Limited governance review, no formal veto clearance. Private deliberations, exact votes, and audit of current Q3 are unavailable.
A.confidenceRationale: Date appropriate with audit and primary ledger context; exact conduct and events incompletely reviewed.

findings.rationale: Record and refer for integrity review if recurrence or material misstatement emerges. Retained notice insufficient to establish serious policy trigger; formal action already restricted.

A.rationale: Observable conversion variation supports high uncertainty independent of scenario design or return level. WP5 own-model exit PE and growth sensitivities corroborate the consequence.
A.higher: Changes in one material input move the investment result even when all others are held at base.
A.lower: Zero is the canonical high-uncertainty band.

A.limits: Scenario endpoints are joint economic assumptions, not quantified probabilities or statistical confidence intervals.
A.confidenceRationale: Exact verified model and historical dispersion give high confidence in the uncertainty finding.
